purpose: Verify the CFR-GYM-001 lifecycle composed of AFR-GYM-001..006
preconditions: Valid student and faculty records available
action_or_input: Student Admin creates the club with all required data; Observe club status; Student Admin approves the open club; Observe club status
expected_result: Club is created with status open, then after approval its status is confirmed.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-002 composed of AFR-GYM-007..009
preconditions: Actor is applicable Club Head of an existing club
action_or_input: Club Head submits new coordinator and co-coordinator; Observe club leadership; Observe superseded designations
expected_result: Club references the new coordinator and co-coordinator as current leadership and superseded assignments are no longer current.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-003 composed of AFR-GYM-010..015
action_or_input: Book session; Book event in same venue/date with non-overlapping slot; Observe stored bookings and notifications
expected_result: Both bookings are accepted and stored; notification is initiated for each.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-004 composed of AFR-GYM-016..022
preconditions: Actor approving is applicable Club Head
action_or_input: Student applies to the confirmed club; Observe application status; Club Head lists pending applications and approves with remarks; Observe application status and remarks
expected_result: Application is recorded open, then confirmed with remarks retained.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-005 composed of AFR-GYM-023..028
preconditions: Student belongs to selected target group
action_or_input: Club Head creates poll; Observe notification to target students; Student views poll and casts one vote; Observe tally
expected_result: Poll is created active with expiration date and choices; target students notified; student's vote accepted and tally records it.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-006 composed of AFR-GYM-029..031
action_or_input: Submit budget request with all fields and supporting file; Observe stored request
expected_result: Request is stored with status open.

purpose: Verify CFR-GYM-007 composed of AFR-GYM-032..034
preconditions: Faculty user is assigned Club Faculty Councillor of the club
action_or_input: Club Head submits event report with file; Councillor lists reports for the club; Councillor opens the report
expected_result: Report is stored; the assigned councillor can list it and access metadata and file; no approval/rejection state is created.

purpose: Verify: Student Admin creates club recording all listed fields
action_or_input: Submit create-club with all fields; Read the created club
expected_result: Club is created and records name, category, coordinator, co-coordinator, Club Faculty Councillor and description as submitted.

purpose: Verify invalid coordinator assignment is rejected during club creation
preconditions: The selected coordinator is not a valid student
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the invalid coordinator.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected because the coordinator is not a valid student.

purpose: Verify invalid co-coordinator assignment is rejected during club creation
preconditions: The selected co-coordinator is not a valid student
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the invalid co-coordinator.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected because the co-coordinator is not a valid student.

purpose: Verify: Valid faculty member accepted as Club Faculty Councillor
action_or_input: Submit create-club with valid faculty; Observe outcome
expected_result: Validation passes; club is created.

purpose: Verify: Each allowed category accepted (Technical, Sports, Cultural)
action_or_input: For each allowed category submit create-club; Observe outcome
expected_result: Each submission is accepted and the club records the submitted category.

purpose: Verify: Newly created club has status open
action_or_input: Create club; Read club status
expected_result: Club status is open.

purpose: Verify: Student Admin approves an open club; status becomes confirmed
action_or_input: Approve the open club; Read club status
expected_result: Club status is confirmed.

purpose: Verify: Applicable Club Head replaces coordinator and co-coordinator
preconditions: Actor is the applicable current Club Head
action_or_input: Submit leadership change; Read club
expected_result: Club coordinator and co-coordinator are the new assignees.

purpose: Verify an invalid replacement coordinator is rejected
preconditions: An applicable Club Head and an existing club are available
The replacement coordinator is not a valid student
action_or_input: Submit a leadership change with the invalid replacement coordinator.
expected_result: The leadership change is rejected because the replacement coordinator is not a valid student.

purpose: Verify an invalid replacement co-coordinator is rejected
preconditions: An applicable Club Head and an existing club are available
The replacement co-coordinator is not a valid student
action_or_input: Submit a leadership change with the invalid replacement co-coordinator.
expected_result: The leadership change is rejected because the replacement co-coordinator is not a valid student.

purpose: Verify: Only current coordinator and co-coordinator remain current after change
preconditions: Club has current coordinator C1 and co-coordinator C2
action_or_input: Submit change to C3/C4; Read current leadership designations for the club
expected_result: Current leadership assignments are only C3 and C4; C1 and C2 no longer current.

purpose: Verify: Club Head books a session with all fields including optional poster
action_or_input: Submit session booking; Read stored session
expected_result: Session is stored with submitted values; booking confirmed.

purpose: Verify a session accepts a start time before its end time
preconditions: An applicable Club Head and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit a session booking with start time earlier than end time.
expected_result: The session booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify an event accepts a start time before its end time
preconditions: An applicable Club Head, valid faculty context, and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit an event booking with start time earlier than end time.
expected_result: The event booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify a session rejects equal start and end times
preconditions: An applicable Club Head and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit a session booking with start time equal to end time.
expected_result: The session booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify an event rejects equal start and end times
preconditions: An applicable Club Head, valid faculty context, and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit an event booking with start time equal to end time.
expected_result: The event booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify a session rejects a start time later than its end time
preconditions: An applicable Club Head and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit a session booking with start time later than end time.
expected_result: The session booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify an event rejects a start time later than its end time
preconditions: An applicable Club Head, valid faculty context, and a configured venue are available
action_or_input: Submit an event booking with start time later than end time.
expected_result: The event booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify overlapping sessions in the same venue and date are rejected
preconditions: An existing session occupies a venue on a date
An applicable Club Head attempts another session in that venue and date with overlapping time
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping session booking.
expected_result: The overlapping session booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify overlapping events in the same venue and date are rejected
preconditions: An existing event occupies a venue on a date
An applicable Club Head attempts another event in that venue and date with overlapping time
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping event booking.
expected_result: The overlapping event booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify an overlapping session and event in the same venue and date are rejected
preconditions: An existing session or event occupies a venue on a date
An applicable Club Head attempts the other booking type in that venue and date with overlapping time
action_or_input: Submit the overlapping booking.
expected_result: The overlapping booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify: Notification initiated after a session is successfully booked
action_or_input: Book session; Observe notification service for new-session notification
expected_result: After a session is successfully booked, notification is initiated or delivered as specified.

purpose: Verify: Club Head books an event with all listed details
action_or_input: Submit event booking; Read stored event
expected_result: Event stored with submitted values.

purpose: Verify: Notification initiated after an event is successfully booked
action_or_input: Book event; Observe notification service
expected_result: After an event is successfully booked, notification is initiated or delivered as specified.

purpose: Verify: Student applies to a confirmed club with description/achievements
action_or_input: Submit application; Read application
expected_result: Application accepted and records the description/achievements.

purpose: Verify: Student holds applications to two different clubs
action_or_input: Apply to Club A; Apply to Club B; Read applications
expected_result: Both applications exist.

purpose: Verify: Duplicate application to same club rejected; existing unchanged
preconditions: Student has open application to Club A
action_or_input: Submit second application to Club A; Read applications
expected_result: Duplicate rejected; existing application unchanged; no second application.

purpose: Verify: New application is recorded with status open
action_or_input: Submit application; Read status
expected_result: Status is open.

purpose: Verify: Applicable Club Head accesses pending applications for own club
preconditions: open applications exist for the club and for another club
action_or_input: Request pending applications for the club; Observe list
expected_result: Open applications for the club are returned; those of other clubs are not.

purpose: Verify: Club Head approves open application with remarks
action_or_input: Approve application with remarks; Read application
expected_result: Approval accepted; remarks stored.

purpose: Verify: Approved application changes from open to confirmed
action_or_input: Approve; Read status
expected_result: Status is confirmed.

purpose: Verify: Club Head creates poll with all listed attributes
action_or_input: Create poll; Read poll
expected_result: Poll created with title, description, expiration date, choices and target groups.

purpose: Verify: Poll with exactly two choices accepted
action_or_input: Create poll; Observe
expected_result: Poll created.

purpose: Verify: Students in selected target groups are notified on poll creation
preconditions: students exist in target group G1 and non-target group G2
action_or_input: Create poll; Observe notifications
expected_result: Students in G1 are notified.

purpose: Verify: Eligible targeted student accesses active poll and its choices
action_or_input: Request poll details; Observe
expected_result: Poll and available choices are presented.

purpose: Verify: Eligible student casts one choice in an active poll
action_or_input: Submit vote; Observe
expected_result: Vote accepted.

purpose: Verify: Accepted vote is recorded in the poll tally
preconditions: tally of chosen option is n
action_or_input: Vote for option O; Read tally
expected_result: Tally of O is n+1; other options unchanged.

purpose: Verify: Club Head submits budget request with all fields
action_or_input: Submit request; Read stored request
expected_result: Request accepted and stored with submitted values.

purpose: Verify a negative budget amount is rejected
preconditions: An applicable Club Head is available
All other budget request data is valid
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a negative amount.
expected_result: The budget request is rejected.

purpose: Verify a missing supporting file is rejected
preconditions: An applicable Club Head is available
The amount and other budget request data are valid
action_or_input: Submit a budget request without the required supporting file.
expected_result: The budget request is rejected.

purpose: Verify: Submitted budget request stored with status open
action_or_input: Submit valid request; Read status
expected_result: Status is open for tracking.

purpose: Verify: Club Head submits event report with all listed fields
action_or_input: Submit report; Read stored report
expected_result: Report stored and available in the club repository.

purpose: Verify: Report without report/details file rejected
action_or_input: Submit; Observe
expected_result: Report not accepted.

purpose: Verify: Assigned councillor lists and opens submitted reports for own club
preconditions: Faculty authenticated and assigned as councillor
action_or_input: List reports; Open one report
expected_result: Report metadata and file available for review.
